fields.summary_ko.0: Visa (V) expands 'Agentic Ready' program for AI agent-based commerce, securing 140+ early participants including Adyen, Stripe, and PayPal, with plans to onboard additional partners in 2027.
fields.summary_ko.1: Early establishment of AI agent payment standards strengthens competitive advantage and preserves transaction volume in emerging commerce channels; however, revenue target disclosure absence makes near-term earnings contribution assessment difficult.
